items.title: Stable power-tempered pair-potential model
items.design_state: Draft definition carrier recorded; scoped checks and independent review remain pending.
items.statement:
Fix a positive integer $d$ and use the Euclidean space $\mathbb R^d$ with norm
$\|x\|_2=\sqrt{\langle x,x\rangle}$ of [[def-euclidean-inner-product]]. A
pair potential is an even Borel-measurable function
$\phi:\mathbb R^d\to\overline{\mathbb R}$ whose image is contained in
$\mathbb R\cup\{+\infty\}$. Here $\overline{\mathbb R}$ is the extended real
line ([[def-extended-reals]]). Borel measurability means the inverse image of
each Borel subset of $\overline{\mathbb R}$ belongs to the Borel sigma-algebra
generated by open sets in the Euclidean topology on $\mathbb R^d$
([[def-borel-sigma-algebra-on-the-extended-real-line]],
[[def-borel-sigma-algebra]]). Even means $\phi(-x)=\phi(x)$. The value
$+\infty$ represents a forbidden pair separation. Coordinates and
potential values are numerical values in fixed reference length and energy
units.

For $N\ge1$ and an ordered configuration $(q_1,\ldots,q_N)\in(\mathbb R^d)^N$,
define its pair energy by
$$U_N(q_1,\ldots,q_N):=\sum_{1\le i<j\le N}\phi(q_i-q_j),$$
with an empty sum equal to $0$; also put $U_0=0$. The finite sum is in
$\mathbb R\cup\{+\infty\}$, since each pair term is real or $+\infty$.

The pair potential is **stable** if there is a finite constant $B\ge0$ such
that $U_N(q_1,\ldots,q_N)\ge-BN$ for every $N\ge1$ and every configuration.
It is **power-tempered** if there are constants $C,R,\epsilon>0$ such that
$$|\phi(x)|\le C\|x\|_2^{-d-\epsilon}\qquad(\|x\|_2\ge R).$$
The combined model class consists of pair potentials that are both stable and
power-tempered. No condition is imposed on the positive core, which may be
unbounded or infinite, and the tail may have either sign.
items.strategy: Definition carrier is in items/def-tdmath-stable-power-tempered-particle-model.md; no proof obligation applies.

items.title: The thermodynamics measure integral agrees with the shared nonnegative integral
items.design_state: Complete conditional proof recorded; scoped checks and independent review remain pending.
items.statement:
Let $(X,\Sigma,\mu)$ be a measure space and let $f:X\to[0,+\infty]$ be
$\Sigma$-measurable. The nonnegative integral defined by
[[def-tdmath-measure-integral]] equals the shared nonnegative Lebesgue integral
defined by [[def-nonnegative-lebesgue-integral]], with the same value in
$[0,+\infty]$.
items.strategy: proof_strategy: direct; complete numbered argument is in items/lem-tdmath-measure-integral-agrees-with-root-lebesgue-integral.md and its proof contract.

items.title: Stability gives finite grand normalization and an exponential particle cutoff
items.design_state: Complete conditional proof recorded; scoped checks and independent review remain pending.
items.statement:
Assume the Axiom of Countable Choice $\mathrm{AC}_\omega$
([[def-countable-choice]]). Let $d\ge1$, let $\phi$ be a stable pair
potential as in [[def-tdmath-stable-power-tempered-particle-model]] with
stability constant $B$, and fix $a,\beta>0$. In fixed reference length and
energy units, put $\Lambda_L=[0,L]^d$ and define, for $N\ge1$,
$$Z_{L,N}:=\frac{a^N}{N!}\int_{\Lambda_L^N}e^{-\beta U_N(q_1,\ldots,q_N)}\,d\lambda_d^{\otimes N},$$
where $\lambda_d$ is Lebesgue measure restricted to the Borel subsets of
$\mathbb R^d$, $\lambda_d^{\otimes N}$ is its $N$-fold product measure. The
integrand uses the ordinary real exponential when $U_N<+\infty$ and is defined
to be $0$ when $U_N=+\infty$. Also,
$\int_{\Lambda_L^N}f\,d\lambda_d^{\otimes N}$ abbreviates the nonnegative
integral of $f\mathbf1_{\Lambda_L^N}$ on the full product space, using
[[def-tdmath-measure-integral]]. Set $Z_{L,0}=1$.
Define $\Xi_L:=\sum_{N=0}^{\infty}Z_{L,N}$ as the nonnegative extended sum of
[[def-nonnegative-extended-series]]. For $L\ge1$ put
$Q:=a e^{\beta B}$. Choose any real $K>eQ+1$ and set
$$n_L:=\lfloor K L^d\rfloor+1.$$
which satisfies $K L^d<n_L\le K L^d+1$ by the integer-part lemma
[[lem-integer-part]]. Let
$\Xi_L^{\mathrm{cut}}:=\sum_{N=0}^{n_L}Z_{L,N}$. Then
$$1\le\Xi_L\le e^{Q L^d},\qquad \sum_{N>n_L}Z_{L,N}\le e^{-L^d},\qquad \Xi_L^{\mathrm{cut}}\ge(1-e^{-L^d})\Xi_L.$$
items.strategy: proof_strategy: direct; complete numbered argument is in items/lem-tdmath-particle-exponential-cutoff.md and its proof contract.

items.title: Power tempering bounds interactions between separated cubes
items.design_state: Complete conditional proof recorded; scoped checks and independent review remain pending.
items.statement:
Let $d\ge1$ and let $\phi$ be power-tempered as in
[[def-tdmath-stable-power-tempered-particle-model]], with constants
$C,R,\epsilon>0$. Define
$$S_{d,\epsilon}:=\sum_{m=1}^{\infty}\bigl((2m+1)^d-(2m-1)^d\bigr)m^{-d-\epsilon},\qquad \|k\|_\infty:=\max_{1\le r\le d}|k_r| \quad(k\in\mathbb Z^d).$$
This nonnegative series, defined by [[def-nonnegative-extended-series]],
groups the lattice terms by shells $\|k\|_\infty=m$.
Then $S_{d,\epsilon}<\infty$. Let $\ell>0$, $g\ge R$, and let
$J\subset\mathbb Z^d$ be finite with $M=|J|$. For each $j\in J$, place at most
$n$ particles in the cube $C_j=(\ell+g)j+[0,\ell]^d$, where $n$ is a
nonnegative integer. The total absolute inter-cube energy satisfies
$$\sum_{\substack{j,j'\in J\;j<j'}}\;\sum_{q\in C_j}\sum_{q'\in C_{j'}}|\phi(q-q')|\le\frac C2 M n^2 S_{d,\epsilon}g^{-d-\epsilon}.$$
Here $j<j'$ means any fixed total ordering of the finite set $J$; each
unordered pair of cubes is counted once.
items.strategy: proof_strategy: direct; complete numbered argument is in items/lem-tdmath-separated-cube-tail-bound.md and its proof contract.

items.title: Finite free-cube grand pressure for stable power-tempered pair potentials
items.design_state: Complete conditional proof recorded; scoped checks and independent review remain pending.
items.statement:
Assume $\mathrm{AC}_\omega$ and let $d\ge1$. Let $\phi$ be a stable,
power-tempered pair potential as in
[[def-tdmath-stable-power-tempered-particle-model]], with constants
$B,C,R,\epsilon$ as there. Fix activity $a>0$ and inverse-energy parameter
$\beta>0$ in fixed reference units. Use the free-boundary grand partition sums
$\Xi_L(a,\beta)$ defined in
[[lem-tdmath-particle-exponential-cutoff]]. For $L\ge1$, put
$$p_L(a,\beta):=L^{-d}\log\Xi_L(a,\beta).$$
Then the limit
$$p(a,\beta):=\lim_{L\to\infty}p_L(a,\beta)$$
exists as a finite real number. The assertion is for cubes with free boundary
and the displayed power-tail hypothesis.
items.strategy: proof_strategy: direct; complete numbered argument is in items/thm-tdmath-stable-tempered-free-cube-grand-pressure.md and its proof contract.

items.title: A singular repulsive power tail is stable
items.design_state: Complete conditional proof recorded; scoped checks and independent review remain pending.
items.statement:
Fix $d\ge1$ and $\epsilon>0$. Define
$$\phi_{\mathrm{rep}}(x):=\begin{cases}+\infty,&x=0,\\\|x\|_2^{-d-\epsilon},&x\ne0.\end{cases}$$
This is an even, Borel-measurable stable power-tempered pair potential. It has
an unbounded repulsive core and a nonzero algebraic tail.
items.strategy: proof_strategy: direct; complete numbered argument is in items/ex-tdmath-repulsive-power-tail.md and its proof contract.

items.title: A hard core stabilizes an attractive power tail
items.design_state: Complete conditional proof recorded; scoped checks and independent review remain pending.
items.statement:
Fix an integer $d\ge1$ and constants $c,\epsilon>0$. Set $p=d+\epsilon$ and
define the even radial pair potential
$$\phi_{\mathrm{att}}(x):=\begin{cases}+\infty,&\|x\|_2<1,\\-c\|x\|_2^{-p},&\|x\|_2\ge1.\end{cases}$$
It has a hard core and a nonzero attractive power tail.
items.strategy: proof_strategy: direct; complete numbered argument is in items/ex-tdmath-hard-core-attractive-power-tail.md and its proof contract.
